text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Sakura Chiyono O contacts me
to let me
know she's going to be late for
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of tasks I can do on my
own until
she gets here. I'm getting
things ready for her
arrival when...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Look! Maruzensky's running!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huff...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wow! She's so cool! But... is it just me, or
does her
running lack the oomph it used
to have? Maybe it's just
my
imagination...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Dummy. It's been a while since she's run,
so of course
she can't go full tilt right
away.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I bet she's running at 70% capacity or so
until she gets
back into the groove of
things.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that makes sense! I can't wait to see
her when she's
at full power again!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmm... If only that were the case...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So my full-out sprint just looks like a
warm-up jog
to others now...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...But they're right. This isn't me. The
Umamusume
Chiyo looks up to is better
than this...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Time to clean the rust off my gears!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry I'm late, Trainer! Let's have a
good
day of training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow, there sure are a lot of people
around
today! Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: WHAAAT?!
choice_data_list: Maruzensky was running right up until a moment ago...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Why didn't you message me?! I wanted
to watch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O starts trembling like a
puppy.
It's been a long time since I've
seen her like this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Of course I do. I wouldn't try so hard
to be like
her if I didn't.
choice_data_list: You really do look up to Maruzensky, don't you.
You really look up to Maruzensky, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was ready to give up and
accept my
fate as an average
Umamusume, she showed me a
future
where I blossom.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And you...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You're the one helping me toward that
future.
Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...What?! No, um, I...
choice_data_list: Did getting all this ready make you late...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Please just accept the gift and don't
worry about
how it might be connected
with my lateness...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
B-but I suppose that doesn't make things
any less
awkward... Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! In exchange for you
accepting this,
can I ask you for a favor?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Could you please tell me what Maruzen's
running
was like?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If you tell me, we can count that as your
return
gift for these chocolates. What do
you think?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! But you have to tell me everything
in full
detail!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I try to describe Maruzensky's
running to
Sakura Chiyono O in as much
detail as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I try to describe Maruzensky's
running to
Sakura Chiyono O in as much
detail as possible.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whew... That was a lot of work. I guess
that's it
for training today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'll see you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Sakura Chiyono O waves goodbye, I
suddenly
remember the chocolates from
her in my pocket.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: Can I do one more thing to make it up to you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Munch! Gulp! Phew! This sure is delicious.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you're okay with paying for
this?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. I can't believe I'm getting
treated to meat
buns in exchange for
giving you chocolate. I'm so
lucky!
choice_data_list: This is nothing, I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Thank you so much for the treat.
We even
finished eating at the same
time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. True...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
How about we get one more? I'll split it
with you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wow! Are you sure?! Yayyy!
choice_data_list: Don't say thatâI'll treat you to a whole one!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll get a chocolate bun, since it's

Valentine's Day and everything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O turns to dash off to
the
convenience store, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She stumbles and nearly does a face
plant. In the
nick of time, I grab her
shoulders and pull her
back up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sorry... My legs got all tangled up...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I know... I can't believe I just did
something so
silly in front of you...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sigh... But...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... The way you saved me just now...
It made
you seem even cooler than
usual.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I got to see such an awesome side
of you
today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okaaay.
choice_data_list: Hey now, don't get carried away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch over Sakura Chiyono O to make
sure she
doesn't trip again on our way
back to the
academy.
